hero.heading: Hi, I'm Sarah Yaseen
hero.intro: A creative digital professional with 3 years of experience building clean, modern, and user-friendly digital experiences — from responsive WordPress websites and intuitive UI/UX designs in Figma, to eye-catching graphic designs and ready-to-edit Etsy templates in Canva.

about.content: I'm Sarah Yaseen, a WordPress Developer and UI/UX Designer with 3 years of experience creating clean, modern, and user-friendly digital experiences for web and mobile. I specialize in designing intuitive interfaces and smooth user journeys in Figma, and building fully responsive WordPress websites using Elementor. I also bring a strong eye for visual design — creating graphics and Etsy-ready templates that are both functional and beautiful. My focus is always on combining aesthetics with usability to deliver effective, engaging design solutions.

expertise.title: WordPress Development
expertise.description: Building responsive, SEO-friendly websites using WordPress & Elementor for businesses across industries.

expertise.title: UI/UX Design
expertise.description: Designing intuitive user interfaces and end-to-end user flows in Figma for web and mobile apps.

expertise.title: Graphic Designing
expertise.description: Creating scroll-stopping social media ads, banners, and branded visual content.

expertise.title: Etsy Digital Products
expertise.description: Designing editable Canva templates (flyers, brochures, social posts) sold as digital products on Etsy.

cta.heading: Let's Work Together
cta.description: Always open to new opportunities and collaborations in WordPress development, UI/UX, and design.

projects.title: German Car Service Website
projects.description: I designed and developed this German car service website using WordPress with Elementor, focusing on creating a modern, clean, and user-friendly interface for an automotive service brand. The website includes a well-structured layout, clear service presentation, and smooth navigation to ensure a seamless user experience. Built with Elementor, the design is fully responsive and optimized for all devices, maintaining both functionality and visual appeal.

projects.title: LLC Business Website Design
projects.description: This project involved designing and developing a professional WordPress website for an LLC business using Elementor. The website focuses on a clean, modern layout with a user-friendly interface to clearly present the company's services, brand identity, and contact information. The design is fully responsive and optimized for performance, ensuring a smooth experience across all devices.

projects.title: Dubai Urgent Visa Website
projects.description: This project focused on designing and developing a fast, user-friendly WordPress website for Dubai urgent visa services using Elementor. The website highlights urgent visa options, clear call-to-action sections, and an easy application flow. The design emphasizes trust, clarity, and responsiveness to ensure users can quickly find information and apply across all devices.

projects.title: GCCF – Global Climate Change Foundation Website
projects.description: This project involved designing and developing an informative and impact-focused WordPress website for the Global Climate Change Foundation (GCCF) using Elementor. The website was created to effectively communicate the foundation's mission, climate initiatives, and global impact. A clean, modern UI with a strong focus on accessibility, responsiveness, and user experience was implemented to ensure clear storytelling and easy navigation across all devices.

projects.title: Limitless Repair Co – Credit Repair Website
projects.description: This project involved designing and developing a professional WordPress website for Limitless Repair Co, a credit repair service provider. The website was built using Elementor with a clean, trustworthy, and modern design to clearly explain credit repair services, benefits, and the client process. Special attention was given to UI/UX, clear call-to-action sections, and responsive design.

projects.title: New England Agency – AI Solutions Website
projects.description: This project involved designing and developing a modern WordPress website for New England Agency, an AI-focused agency. The website was built using Elementor with a sleek, tech-driven design to showcase AI services, solutions, and innovation. Strong emphasis was placed on UI/UX, clear content structure, and responsive layouts.

projects.title: Own Aim Construction Website
projects.description: This project involved designing and developing a professional WordPress website for Own Aim Construction. The website was built using Elementor with a strong, clean, and modern layout to showcase construction services, completed projects, and company expertise. The design focuses on clear structure, trust-building visuals, and full responsiveness.

projects.title: Surplus Recovery – Real Estate Website
projects.description: This project involved designing and developing a professional WordPress website for a real estate surplus recovery service. Built using Elementor, the website focuses on a clean, trustworthy, and informative design to explain surplus recovery services, eligibility, and the claim process. Special attention was given to UI/UX, clear call-to-action sections, and responsive design.

projects.title: AirLift-Style Ride Booking Web App
projects.description: I designed a complete web application interface for an AirLift-style ride booking platform using Figma. This project focuses on creating a smooth end-to-end experience for both commuters and drivers, covering key flows such as authentication, ride booking, payment, booking success, and ride posting.

projects.title: Quick Oil Change Service Finder UI/UX Design
projects.description: I designed this Quick Oil Change Service Finder web page in Figma, focusing on a clean layout, easy navigation, and intuitive filters. The design highlights service providers with clear pricing, reviews, and quick booking options to enhance user experience and accessibility.

projects.title: First Alert – Fleet Safety & Incident Management Dashboard
projects.description: I designed the UI for First Alert, a real-time fleet safety and incident management platform, in Figma. The system allows companies to report incidents, monitor alerts, manage tasks, and track safety performance through a complete dashboard experience including a 6-step reporting wizard, multi-channel alerts, and AI-based risk insights. My focus was to create a modern dark-themed interface with clear data hierarchy, strong usability, and a scalable component-based design system.
